notes:
Live odds from the sportsbooks, with your own free key.

- New Odds source page: paste a free key from The Odds API (500 credits a month). It is kept in your Mac's Keychain and only ever sent to The Odds API.
- The Arbitrage page can then read live odds from the major US sportsbooks and find arbs, +EV bets and middles across them. Each refresh says what it will cost in credits before it runs, and how many you have left after.
- Only regulated US sportsbooks are suggested as bets; Pinnacle and the exchanges are used to price the fair odds.
